description: This file contains unit tests for network address iterators and adapters in the WPEFramework core module, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for network adapters, providing methods to iterate over and access network adapter properties.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for IPv4 addresses, providing methods to traverse and access individual IPv4 addresses.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for IPv6 addresses, providing methods to traverse and access individual IPv6 addresses.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observer class for network adapter events with notification callback mechanism.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Retrieves the name associated with the network adapter.

methods.name: IPV4Addresses
methods.description: Returns an IPV4AddressIterator for the associated adapter.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of addresses in the iterator.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the current IP address node.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to its initial position.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Sets the operational state of the adapter.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the adapter in string or binary form.
